messages.content: do we have full specs for notification system ? If yes provide please

Yes — full spec exists and is marked "Spec Complete" (module #30, Admin/Core section, Core tier — always active regardless of subscription tier). It's **not built in Bubble yet** (all 46 modules are roadmap-status), but the design is fully locked. Source: `specs/CRS_Blueprint.html` lines 3279–3990.

## Notifications Module — Summary

**Architecture:** In-app + Email active for MVP; Push channel infrastructure-ready but dormant.

**5 Data Types:**
| DT | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Notification` | One row per recipient per event. v20: supports 3 recipient kinds (internal `User`, `ApplicantAccount`, or raw `recipient_email`) via nullable FKs + `recipient_kind` discriminator — exactly one must be set. |
| `NotificationPreferences` | 1-per-user, auto-created on signup. Global toggles (in-app/email/push) + list of `EventPreference`. |
| `EventPreference` | Per-event channel override, only created when user deviates from default. |
| `Subscription` | Watch/Follow. Auto-subscribe on create/assign; user can manually watch/unwatch/mute. |
| `EmailTemplate` | Body per event, v20 fallback chain: company+language → company+en → global+language → global+en → hardcoded. |

**3 Option Sets:** `OS - Notification Event Type` (the event catalog — code, module, default channels, severity, batching window, template key), `OS - Notification State` (Unread/Read/Archived), `OS - Recipient Kind`.

**Key mechanics:**
- **Dedupe:** one notification per (user + event + entity).
- **Batching:** grouped by (recipient + event_type + module + time window) — 15min for creates, 10min updates, 5min assignments, 0min (immediate) for critical events like permission approvals/role changes. This is a WU-cost control, not just UX polish.
- **Delivery pipeline:** `trigger_notification` → schedules `deliver_to_user` per recipient → schedules `send_notification_email`. Check-on-fire guard for idempotency, no reschedule races.
- **Privacy:** strict recipient-only, **no admin override** — even admins can't read other users' notification content (audit goes through `ActivityLog` instead).
- **Retention:** Unread indefinite; Read non-critical archives at 30d, deletes at 90d; critical kept 1 year regardless of state.

**UI:** Bell dropdown (last 10-15, unread badge) + `/notifications` full page + `/settings/notifications` preferences (grouped Module → Submodule, checkbox grid per event/channel).

Already mapped to live Bubble: legacy `notification` DT exists (16 fields, tenant-scoped) but currently has **NO privacy rules** (`brain/database.md:52`) — that's the gap between spec and reality if/when this gets built.
